audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia's ultimate is called 'Ionian Fervor (R)' in four places and is said to disarm your autos and Silver Bolts. Ionian Fervor is her PASSIVE, the ult is Vanguard's Edge, and nothing in it disarms.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ionian Fervor is the passive stacking attack speed. Vanguard's Edge fires blades that damage and Mark enemies, then form a wall that damages and slows anyone walking through — 950 range, 125/105/85s. There is no disarm. This is the worst kind of error to ship: a player told their autos are shut off will disengage from a fight they could win, and will not think about the wall that actually cuts their retreat.
audit.corrected: Name it Vanguard's Edge, describe the Mark plus the damaging slow wall, and delete the disarm.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagree with the already-applied mirror.
audit.why: Mirror (irelia__vayne) landed Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Vayne. Levels 1-2 are Vayne's because Irelia is melee with a single 15-mana Bladesurge and no stacks yet; Level 3 hinges on whether Flawless Duet lands; 4 through the first item are hers on reset mobility and sustain; two items flip to percent-max-HP true damage plus Final Hour.
audit.corrected: Chart: Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Vayne, as matched pairs with ratings and the contradicted whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere (packet: sequencingCues 1) and Bladesurge's refund condition was stated wrong.
audit.why: Bladesurge refreshes only if the target is Marked or dies to it — not off any minion. Flawless Duet is 850 range on 16s falling to 10s and applies the Mark that feeds the refund. Defiant Dance is 20s falling to 12s and reduces physical damage while charging. Those three numbers define every trade window.
audit.corrected: Refund condition and the 850/16s stun written into the do's and the early text.

edits.after: At Level 1 Vayne's 550 range beats a melee Irelia who has only a 15-mana dash.

edits.before: Her stacked passive autos and W poke-block keep Level 2 firmly in Irelia's favour.
edits.after: At Level 2 Tumble's reset lands three Silver Bolts before she can stack Ionian Fervor.

edits.before: Flawless Duet stun into stacked autos locks Vayne down at Level 3.
edits.after: At Level 3 it hinges on Flawless Duet: dodge the 850 stun and it's even.

edits.before: Ionian Fervor at Level 6 disarms Vayne's autos and Silver Bolts inside the R field.
edits.after: At Level 6 Vanguard's Edge marks you and walls your retreat with a damaging slow.

edits.before: Ionian Fervor (R) resets her stacks and gives her a disarm zone that shuts off your autos and Silver Bolts entirely — if she R's you and lands E, you're stunned and dead. Keep max distance, save Condemn to cancel her engage, and never fight inside her R field.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge (R) is 950 range on 125s: the blades damage and Mark you, then form a wall that damages and slows anyone crossing it. Marked means Bladesurge refunds onto you. Keep max distance, hold Condemn for her dash, and never let that wall sit between you and home.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay all hers: E stun into stacked autos locks you down, Q-reset mobility chases through your kite, and at 6 Ionian Fervor (R) disarms your autos and Silver Bolts entirely. Max distance, save Condemn for her engage, and never fight in her R field.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are hers: Flawless Duet's 850 stun into stacked autos locks you down, Bladesurge refunds chase you through your kite, and at 6 Vanguard's Edge marks you and drops a wall across your retreat. Hold Condemn for her dash and never fight with that wall behind you.

edits.before: Irelia beats you from Level 1 — Bladesurge (Q) resets off minions to gap-close, her stacked passive autos out-trade you, and her W blocks your poke before Silver Bolts even matter. Farm at range and never stand near a low minion she can dash through.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours — she is melee with one 15-mana Bladesurge, so Tumble in, stack three Silver Bolts and leave. Bladesurge only refunds if the target is Marked or dies, so never stand beside a low minion she can dash through.

edits.before: Disarm your autos and Silver Bolts inside Ionian Fervor (R)
edits.after: Wall off your retreat with Vanguard's Edge (R) blades

edits.before: Her engage CC. Condemn the follow-up. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Flawless Duet reaches 850 on 16s and Marks you — dodge the convergence.

edits.before: Irelia wastes Flawless Duet (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bladesurge only refunds on a Marked target or on a kill — deny both.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A big wave is just a row of Bladesurge stepping stones to you.

notes: Most serious defect in my slice so far, and the packet did not flag it: Irelia's ultimate was named 'Ionian Fervor (R)' (that is her passive; the ult is Vanguard's Edge) and was described as a disarm zone that shuts off autos and Silver Bolts in four separate strings. Riot's Vanguard's Edge has no disarm at all — it Marks and leaves a damaging, slowing wall. A player acting on the old text disengages from winnable fights and ignores the wall that actually cuts their escape. Bladesurge's refund condition (Marked target or a kill) was also stated as 'resets off minions', which is wrong. diff reads 'EVEN' with an 8.5/10 diffRating and a red tone on a 48.55% lane — left alone, but worth a pass.
